item.title: Elm Studio: Commercial Data Scientist
item.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Commercial Data Scientist

Elm Studio is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Elm Studio’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Elm Studio's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Elm Studio, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

item.title: Flint Networks: Legal Ops
item.description:
Headquarters: NYC or Remote (EST or CST)

About the role:

Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. This is a builder role.

item.title: Garnet Systems: Senior Risk Associate
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Garnet Systems is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Garnet Systems's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.
